title: Cycle 17: Latency-Aware Routing
weak_spots: Reliability scorecard ignored observed request/probe latency
ModelHealthService returned only health state, losing duration
Chat streams measured no total duration or TTFT
MemoryStore schema had no latency columns
Models tab showed health but no latency signal

next_options.name: Adaptive concurrency / parallel warmup routing
next_options.summary: Issue small warmup probes to multiple providers/models in parallel and route the live request to whichever returns the lowest TTFT (Zeph/Anyscale pattern).

next_options.name: Cross-provider failover
next_options.summary: Allow fallback and predictive selection to switch providers when the current provider is entirely unhealthy, not just pick another model within the same provider.

next_options.name: Latency SLO user preference
next_options.summary: Expose a configurable target latency SLO in the Models tab and tune the composite penalty curve so users can prefer responsiveness over cost or raw reliability.

notes: Chat e2e tests now pass an in-memory VolatileMemoryStore reliability backend to avoid opening the persistent SQLCipher database on every scenario.
Schema version bumped to 4; durable-memory e2e assertion updated to expect version 4.
